hypotheses.V1_layer0_axis_semantics: At least 16 of 32 layer-0 joint axes have best current-token magnitude AUROC at least 0.70.
hypotheses.V2_layer17_axis_semantics: At least 8 of 32 layer-17 joint axes have best next-token magnitude AUROC at least 0.65.
hypotheses.V3_coefficient_concentration: Median effective concept support of normalized diagonal coefficients is at most 7 for both layers.
hypotheses.V4_non_native_axes: Median maximum absolute cosine with any native Left or Right factor is below 0.50 for both layers.
hypotheses.V5_coefficient_activation_agreement: The strongest coefficient concept matches the strongest activation concept for at least 25% of axes at each layer.
